divergences.code: src/oep_client/host.py:Unsupported.supported; riscv.py:Wire.attach (dpc), Wire._take_target_id, RiscvDm.step (step_left); arm.py:SwdWire.attach (target_id); capture.py:LogicCapture.status (error), _config, AnalogCapture.calibration
